translation: It ascends to Fengfu (GV16), (one cun into the hairline behind the neck, within the great sinew, in the hollow) and meets Foot-Taiyang and Yangwei, entering together into the brain. It runs along Naohu (GV17), (on the occipital bone) Qiangjian (GV18), (three cun behind Baihui) Houding (GV19), (one and a half cun behind Baihui) ascends the crown, passes Baihui (GV20), (in the whorl of hair at the center of the crown) Qianding (GV21), (one and a half cun in front of Baihui) Xinhui (GV22), (three cun in front of Baihui, that is, the fontanel) Shangxing (GV23), (one cun in front of Xinhui) to Shenting (GV24), (two cun in front of Xinhui, directly above the nose, five fen into the hairline) as the meeting of Foot-Taiyang and the Du vessel. It runs along the middle of the forehead to the nasal bridge, passes Suliao (GV25), (the tip of the nose) Shuigou (GV26), (that is, the philtrum) meets the Hand and Foot Yangming, reaches Duiduan (GV27), (at the upper end of the lip) enters Yinjiao (GV28), (in the gap between the upper teeth) and meets and joins with the Ren vessel and Foot-Yangming, then ends.
